title: Efficient Shallow Ritz Method: 1D Semi-Linear Diffusion-Reaction and Allen-Cahn Equations
summary: An efficient shallow Ritz method was developed in [8, 9] for one-dimensional linear diffusion and diffusion-reaction problems. In this paper, the method is extended to a nonlinear diffusion-reaction equation with a cubic reaction term: (1) a basic error estimate of the shallow Ritz discretization is established and (2) a reduced block Newton (rBN) method for solving the resulting non-convex optimization problem is developed.
